system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the abstract Quicksort sorting algorithm specification. It extends the main Quicksort module and provides a finite-state override of the sequence operator, limiting sequences to a bounded maximum length so that the model checker can exhaustively explore the state space.
actors_and_components: Same as the Quicksort specification: a single sequential sorting procedure. This module adds no new actors but introduces a constant for the maximum sequence length.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the Quicksort specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the Quicksort specification, but with sequences restricted to those having length at most the configured maximum sequence length.
actions: Inherits all actions from the Quicksort specification without modification.
safety_properties: Inherits from the Quicksort specification. The model-checking configuration checks the partial correctness postcondition, the type invariant, and the full inductive invariant.
liveness_properties: The model-checking configuration checks the termination property (the algorithm eventually reaches its terminal state).
model_bounds: The value set is configured as a specific finite set of integers (e.g., three integers). The maximum sequence length is set to a small value (e.g., 4). The sequence operator is overridden to produce only sequences up to the maximum length.
additional_assumptions: The maximum sequence length must be a natural number. The overridden sequence operator generates all functions from index ranges 1 through k (for k from 1 to the maximum length) into the value set.
